turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Owen's essay. Why is there a zero beside his name?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No, thank you. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Then you'll understand why I want an answer. Who decided on the zero?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.
Aren't perfect. The company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have besides a number?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing those times down. Show me the document itself, with the date on it. Did anyone put it to Owen before the zero went in?
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
I'm not here for compliments. The version history, with the date on it. Show me.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not grading you. I'm here about Owen's essay. The version history, Hale.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
Kids misquote Shakespeare all the time. Show me the page in the essay, and the play, so I can look for it myself.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Outlines change. That's what drafting is. You keep telling me what you have, Hale, so put it on the table, the outline and the rest, and let me read it.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? Owen's essay is on the table. Show me the outline.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.
A rewrite for what? You've described documents to me, and I haven't read one. If nothing goes on his record, that goes in writing, and the zero comes off first.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
Are you asking me how to do your job? Owen found out from a gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class. Put the zero in writing as withdrawn, and then we talk about what you show him.
